audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side directly contradicts content win[] on every single row: full says Morgana favoured levels 1-3 and Skill levels 4-6/first item/late, while content win[0-2]=Skill, win[3-5]=Morgana, win[6]=Yuumi — matching the packet levelChart exactly.
audit.why: Neither support has a real early edge (both lack early hard trade tools before Bind/attach matter), Morgana's Dark Binding is the lane's only hard CC through mid-game giving her the all-in, and late Yuumi's scaling sustain and untether mobility outvalue a single Black Shield — exactly what content whys[0..6] already state in detail.
audit.corrected: phases[0-2].side -> Skill, phases[3-5].side -> Morgana, phases[6].side -> Yuumi, ratings and why text adjusted to match the grounded content reasoning.

audit.why: Content spikes already correctly cover Soul Shackles beating Final Chapter's root at 6, the first-item Bind-R kill threat, and Yuumi's late sustain/untether beating a single Black Shield.
